result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where restaurant cards and content are visually cut off, preventing users from seeing complete information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen, making it impossible to see the full card.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card container width or implement proper carousel scrolling to ensure all cards are fully visible or properly scrollable without being truncated.

issues.description: The second restaurant listing in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the visible area - only the pizza image and discount badge are visible, with the restaurant name and details completely hidden.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient vertical space or implement proper scrolling to display complete restaurant cards with all information (name, rating, delivery time, etc.) visible or accessible.
